title: Resolve a path to its seat and the records that claim it
summary: `@inventarch/graph` indexes the path selections records declare in `covers` (`authority.covers` on `@mandate`, `subject.covers` on `@law`, `@convention` and `@playbook`, `work.covers` on `@spec`) and `paths` on `@hook` as Graph claims at load, with unreadable selections listed in invalidClaims, and exports matchesSelection(path, selection) and selectionProblem(selection): a selection is a workspace-relative POSIX path where * matches within one segment, ** matches any number of segments, a trailing / selects a directory and everything under it, and every other character is literal. `@inventarch/db` adds Reader.resolveSeat(path, options), which returns the path's seat (the `@system` of a system folder, else the `@workspace` whose composition.sources root holds it), the records declared at it and the claimants ordered by band then identity, pruned to a scope. A `@workspace` composition.sources entry that is not `<root> @<placement>` now refuses membership with IA-DB-SOURCES-INVALID instead of being ignored, and ia capture refuses it with exit 3 and a next command, writing nothing; DbError gains an optional where ({path, line, identity}), which that refusal carries and ia capture --json reports.
